oil:
n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料
vt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于
vi. 加燃油, 融化

n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water
n. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist
v. cover with oil, as if by rubbing
oil slick: n. 浮油; 漂浮在水面上的油膜
oil tanker:
油轮
[经] 油轮, 油罐车, 加油非机
oilcloth: n. cloth treated on one side with a drying oil or synthetic resin
oiled:
a. 涂油的, 用油防水的, 浸油的
[机] 涂油的, 擦油
oiler:
n. 油商, 加油工, 涂油者, 注油壶
[化] 加油器; 加油者
n. a worker who oils engines or machinery
oilfield: n. a region rich in petroleum deposits (especially one with producing oil wells)
oilman: n. 石油工人, 石油商

n. a person who owns or operates oil wells
n. a worker who produces or sells petroleum
oilseed: n. any of several seeds that yield oil
oilskin: n. 油布, 油布雨衣
n. a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof
oily:
a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的
[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的
s. coated or covered with oil
ointment:
n. 软膏, 油膏
[化] 软膏; 药膏
n. semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation
